text: Dropping leading empty segments makes /src/posting.al match a workspace file, contradicting 'absolute paths still do not match'; a drive prefix could be cancelled away.
evidence: Design: only . segments and NON-leading empty segments are dropped; a leading / or // keeps its root; a drive prefix stays; .. is not cancelled. Negative test T1n (/src/posting.al and src/../src/posting.al stay unmatched, original spelling kept); its mutation drops the leading empty segment.

text: '..' cancellation is not equivalent to the same file (symlinks), and with the pre-existing backslash mapping can collide distinct POSIX files.
evidence: Design: '..' is no longer cancelled (out of scope, stated limit). Rounds 2-3: astra re-raised that the clean-up WIDENS the pre-existing literal-backslash alias (a POSIX file named src\.\x.al now keys like src/x.al). Fixed in the ledger: P4 is scoped to names without a literal backslash; Design and Not delivered state the widened alias and put such names outside the guarantee; no 'not widened' claim remains.

text: T2's stated mutation survives its discriminator (a/../../x.al).
evidence: T2 rewritten with hand-stated pairs incl. src/../x.al -> src/../x.al; mutation 'cancel ..' turns it into x.al and fails.

text: Clarify the order: strip scheme, segments, lowercase.
T1 should assert no file-unmatched diagnostics.
evidence: T1 asserts an empty changedRootsDiagnostics for every spelling.

text: The poisoned-file set has its own normalisation path; a healthy-path diff test does not pin it.
evidence: New T4 extends the existing veto test with mixed ./src and src spellings in both orders.

text: Empty-segment rule is ambiguous: 'except a leading one' contradicts the T2 pair //srv/x.al -> //srv/x.al, and does not say whether 'leading' is counted before or after . is dropped (.//src/x.al).
evidence: Design: the run of empty segments at RAW index 0 (before . is dropped) is kept, at most 2; T2 adds .//src/x.al -> src/x.al and ///src/x.al -> //src/x.al.

text: What a trailing / does is unstated; under the rule src/posting.al/ matches the file.
evidence: Design states a trailing / is dropped (deliberate leniency); T2 adds src/x.al/ -> src/x.al.

text: T4's mutation fails only one mixed direction; in the reverse direction a broken diff lookup also passes unless the diagnostics are pinned exactly.
evidence: T4 now says the mutation fails only the bad=./src direction, asserts diag_kinds == ['diff-parse-error'] in every case, and asserts the precondition that a healthy ./src/posting.al record alone gives roots == ['PostSalesDoc'].

text: T3 is too loose: no header form, no hunk, no expected roots.
evidence: T3 now gives both header forms (--- ./src/... and a/./src/... b/./src/...), a line-9 hunk, and expects exit 0, roots == ['PostSalesDoc'] and empty diagnostics.

text: T1 omits .\src\posting.al, PowerShell's tab-completion spelling, which needs both the backslash mapping and the . drop.
The CHANGELOG (and T3's doc comment) present plain `diff -u ./...` output as fixed, but its headers carry a TAB + timestamp that the parser keeps in the path, so it still gives diff-file-unmatched.
evidence: Fixed in 04c00852: the CHANGELOG names the matched forms (a/./src/x.al, diff -u --label ./src/x.al) and states that plain diff -u timestamped headers are still not parsed (pre-existing parser limit, filed as Discovery 1); T3's doc comment and the ledger T3 line say the same.

text: The headline 'whatever spelling names it' is broader than the change (rooted paths, ..), and the trailing-/ leniency is not mentioned.
evidence: Fixed in 04c00852: headline names the spellings (./, . segments, doubled /, \); 'A trailing / is ignored too (src/x.al/ matches)' added.

text: The doc comment says a UNC // root is kept, but a path made only of slashes ('/' or '//') keys as '/'; the stated rule holds only when a segment follows.
evidence: Fixed in daab14ad: the doc comment states the rule exactly (leading empty run of the raw split, at most 2; /src/x.al and //srv/x.al keep their root; a slash-only path keys as '/', which names no file). Behaviour unchanged (the converged rule).

text: Each diff record runs normalize_input twice (lookup and the poisoned check).
evidence: Fixed in daab14ad: the key is computed once and used for both; cli_digest_changed_spans 43 passed.

evidence: Pre-existing behaviour of the --changed auto-detection (an existing path is taken as a diff file), not a path-spelling issue and outside #76's Acceptance (--file). Filed as Discovery 2.
